name: irving-catholic-tools
description: Maintainer scripts run by hand. Kept out of the repo root on purpose: netlify.toml publishes site/ with no build command, and a root package.json would make Netlify start installing dependencies on every deploy. Nothing here runs in CI or at deploy time. No "type" field: generate-sitemap.js is CommonJS and must stay that way; process-photos.mjs is ESM by extension.
